steps.what: Assemble the approved nursing informatics science text.
Review the note for nursing students and other health professions.
Disseminate the accepted note to the profession and the public.

tasks.design: Approved nursing informatics text is assembled in {DOCS} for a named audience. The specialist reviews it before it is disseminated to students, other professions, or the public. It is sent by {EMAIL} only for the accepted version. A text with no audience id is not assembled.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notes to the profession were rewritten from memory, and an old paragraph sometimes went out with the new one.
tasks.enabler_now: Text the specialist has already approved can be assembled before this review.
tasks.still_hard: A development the approved text does not contain, which the specialist must write.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can see that an approved paragraph is true and still wrong for this audience.
tasks.altitude: Approved text can be assembled. The specialist still reviews the note, and it is sent only for the version that person accepted.

reach.task: Publish only a version a person has accepted, and say so when a desk is not a person.
reach.learn: The accepted version can be shared. The review stays here.

evidence.claim: Text the specialist has already approved can be assembled for a named audience. It is sent only after that person accepts this version.
A note that reaches students or the public is accepted by the specialist first. If a desk answers the public, it says it is not a person.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Text id and audience id, produced by the library of text already approved. Text that has not been approved is not assembled. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Send only by the mail the organisation already uses. Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the informatics specialist.
research_questions: What share of notes are assembled from already approved text?
Which notes are written new for one audience?

already_counted.description: The specialist still reviews the note.

incremental.description: The specialist rewrites a paragraph the approved text did not contain.

approvals.approved_version: note version and the audience ids it names

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling text the specialist has already approved, and sending only that accepted version. It disappears when the paragraph is new and the specialist writes it. The review before sending stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Judge whether a technology fits nursing.

steps.what: List computer technologies already named for nursing education.
Analyze those technologies to determine applicability to nursing practice.
Record the administration or research use the specialist accepts.

tasks.design: Computer technologies already named for nursing education are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist analyzes them to determine applicability to practice, administration, and research. A technology with no name id is not listed. The list does not determine applicability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technology names arrived in vendor mail and were debated without a list of what the service had already looked at.
tasks.enabler_now: A technology already named for nursing education can be listed before the analysis.
tasks.still_hard: A technology that is named and still does not fit this ward's practice.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can tell a technology that teaches well from one that only demonstrates well.
tasks.altitude: Named technologies can be listed. The specialist still determines whether they apply to nursing practice, administration, or research.

reach.task: Name the technology, and leave the judgement of nursing applicability here.
reach.learn: The name can be listed. The applicability stays here.

evidence.claim: A computer technology already named for nursing education can be listed. The list cannot determine whether it applies to practice.
The specialist decides applicability. A name on a list does not authorise the service to adopt the technology.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Technology id, produced by the list the service has already named. A technology with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the list the education lead already keeps. Do not adopt a technology from the list.
unknowns: Who may adopt one for a ward.
research_questions: What share of analyses start from a named technology?
Which adoptions had no prior name on the list?

already_counted.description: The specialist still records the accepted use.

incremental.description: The specialist names a technology the list did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing computer technologies already named for nursing education. It disappears when the technology is not named and the specialist adds it. Determining applicability stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write the policy for introducing technology.

steps.what: List information technology changes already logged for nursing.
Develop the policy for introducing that technology to nursing practice.
Review the procedure for education, administration, or research use.

tasks.design: Information technology changes already logged for nursing are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist develops the strategy or policy for introducing, evaluating, or modifying that technology in practice, administration, education, or research. An item with no change id is not listed. The list does not set the policy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each introduction of a system started a new policy from a blank page, including the parts that had not changed.
tasks.enabler_now: A change already logged can be listed before the specialist writes the policy.
tasks.still_hard: A change that is logged and still needs a policy nobody has written.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can see that a logged change is technical and the policy question is about who may use it.
tasks.altitude: Logged changes can be listed. The specialist still develops the policy for introducing the technology and still reviews the procedure.

reach.task: Log the change, and leave the policy on who may use it with the specialist.
reach.learn: The change id can be shared. The policy stays here.

evidence.claim: An information technology change already logged for nursing can be listed. The list cannot write the policy for introducing it.
The specialist writes the policy and the procedure. A change log does not authorise the introduction.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.
Fields: Change id, produced by the log the service already keeps. A change with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the change log the service already keeps. Do not introduce a technology from the list.
unknowns: Who adopts a policy for a ward.
research_questions: What share of policies start from a logged change?
Which introductions have no change id?

already_counted.description: The specialist still develops the policy.
The specialist still reviews the procedure.

incremental.description: The specialist logs a change the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing information technology changes already logged for nursing. It disappears when the change is not logged and the specialist writes it up. Developing the policy stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List informatics items already tagged for the stored topic.
Read the current literature and talk with colleagues about it.
Participate in professional conferences and record the development.

tasks.design: Informatics items already tagged for the stored topic are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist reads the current literature, talks with colleagues, and participates in professional organizations or conferences. An item with no topic id is not listed. The list does not attend.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each specialist kept a private pile of papers, and the same article was read three times under three titles.
tasks.enabler_now: An item already tagged to the topic can be listed before the specialist reads.
tasks.still_hard: A development that is not tagged, and a conversation that only happens in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can hear a colleague contradict a paper the list treated as settled.
tasks.altitude: Tagged items can be listed. The specialist still reads, still talks with colleagues, and still goes to the conference.

reach.task: Pass a tagged item, and still leave the reading and the conference with the specialist.
reach.learn: The item can be listed. The reading stays here.

evidence.claim: An informatics item already tagged to a stored topic can be listed. The list cannot read the literature or attend a conference.
Keeping up with the field is the specialist's own work. A list does not join a professional organisation or speak for the specialist.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Topic id and item id, produced by the tags the specialist has already applied. An item with no topic id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the library the specialist already tags. Do not treat a tag as a judgement that the item is correct.
unknowns: Which topics the specialist has already tagged.
Which conferences require the specialist in person.
research_questions: What share of reading starts from a tagged item?
Which developments arrive only through a colleague?

already_counted.description: The specialist still reads and talks with colleagues.
The specialist still attends and records the conference.

incremental.description: The specialist tags an item the library did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing informatics items already tagged for the topic. It disappears when the item is untagged and the specialist finds it. Reading, talking with colleagues, and the conference stay with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still decides what other professions should hear, still judges whether a technology fits nursing, and still reads the literature. Approved text can be assembled, and nothing is sent before that person accepts the version.
reach: Web developers publish a page only after a person accepts the version, and this job learns the same gate on a note to the profession.
Computer systems engineers name a technology, and this job learns that naming it does not decide whether nursing should use it.
skills_to_grow: Accept a note version before it is sent to students or the public.
Keep the reading of the literature, and the conference, with the specialist.
role.ambitious_version: Approved text is assembled before the specialist reviews it, and applicability, policy, and the conference stay with that person.
